subject: Finalizing bridging credit for Aug capacity overage — ClearPath
messages:
From: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@clearpath.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: billing@clearpath.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected Aug invoice spike (invoice 3847)

Hi Stephanie —

We just received invoice 3847 for August and there's a ~78% increase vs. the prior month. Our finance team is flagging this as unexpected; we had not authorized additional capacity beyond our renewal. Can you explain what drove the spike and provide a reconciliation? Attaching the invoice we received.

This is blocking our payment runs until we have a short write-up and proposed remediation.

Thanks,
Sarah Lane
Finance Ops | ClearPath AI

Attachment: CP_Invoice_3847.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@clearpath.ai>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected Aug invoice spike (invoice 3847)

Sarah —

Thanks for the heads-up and for attaching the invoice. I dug into usage and the short version: ClearPath ran a two-week pilot expansion (internal project "Aug Edge Pilot") that significantly increased token throughput between Aug 15–28. That pilot was launched by your engineering team and autoscaling retained peak instances longer than expected, which produced the surge.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- We issue a one-time bridging credit to cover the portion of overage attributable to the autoscale lag (Aug 15–28).
- Redwood will provide a brief usage reconciliation (line-item by day) and an action plan to prevent recurrence (limits & alerting).
- We can roll the credit into this invoice or issue a separate credit memo — whichever your AP prefers.

I'm attaching a draft bridging credit note; Markus (Finance) and Rishi (Account Exec) are looped for approval on the amount and process. If you'd like, we can fast-track a DocuSign agreement for the credit to unblock payment.

Proposed amount: $18,400 (calculations attached).

I can jump on a 20-minute call today if helpful.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Account Success | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachment: bridging_credit_note_CP-4821.pdf (PDF, stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: bridging credit proposal for CP-4821 — draft numbers

Stephanie / Rishi —

Quick internal note from Finance: the $18.4k looks in-line with the daily consumption delta and is acceptable as a one-time operational credit. Two asks before we sign off:
1) Confirm the precise time window being credited (start/end timestamps) so we can tie it to the invoice lines.
2) Flag whether this is a goodwill credit (no contract amendment) or a conditional credit (e.g., ClearPath agrees to alert thresholds + a short-term usage cap for 60 days).

Prefer the credit issued as a separate credit memo applied to invoice 3847; that keeps the audit trail clean.

-Markus
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@clearpath.ai>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing bridging credit for Aug capacity overage — ClearPath

Sarah —

Appreciate you flagging this. To clarify on the commercial side: Redwood is happy to issue the one-time bridging credit of $18,400 as a goodwill gesture tied to the autoscale lag. In return, we'd ask ClearPath to accept a short operational covenant: enable token-level alerting and a soft cap for 60 days to prevent accidental scale-outs while we validate the autoscale profile. This is not a price change or contract amendment — it's simply to reduce repeat incidents.

If that sounds reasonable, we'll route a DocuSign agreement (one page) for signature and issue the credit memo on countersignature. I'll include our finance contact in the docusign so the applied credit is visible in your payment flow.

Thanks — Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@clearpath.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: billing@clearpath.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing bridging credit for Aug capacity overage — ClearPath

Rishi / Stephanie —

Thanks for the prompt turnaround. ClearPath accepts the one-time bridging credit of $18,400 under the conditional operational covenant (enable alerting + 60-day soft cap). Please send the DocuSign and we'll counter-sign today — I have billing on standby to apply the credit and release payment for the remainder.

Confirming the timeline we agreed on for the credit application: apply to invoice 3847 within 48 hours after countersignature.

I'll sign the DocuSign link you send.

Best,
Sarah Lane
Finance Ops | ClearPath AI

Attachment: docusign_clearpath_bridge_agreement.url (link stub)
